'''2009 2K Event Day 2 Mike Gemme LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Gemme]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' M. Gemme
* '''Deck name:''' Spiderbolz Studios
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
